queries.query: Large language models (LLMs) applied to network operations (NetOps): surveys, system papers, and case studies (prompting, tool use, agentic workflows)
queries.rationale: Establish the scope of recent LLM-for-NetOps work, agentic orchestration frameworks, and system-level case studies to ground research-gap selection.

queries.query: LLM-generated network configuration: intent-to-configuration translation, natural-language-driven config synthesis, examples and evaluation
queries.rationale: Find direct prior work on turning operator intent or natural language into device configs and measured correctness.

queries.query: Network configuration verification and validation tools: Batfish, VeriFlow, Header Space Analysis, NetPlumber, Anteater, configuration verification benchmarks
queries.rationale: Collect deterministic validators and formal tools used to check config correctness or reachability; necessary for generate-validate-repair pipelines.

queries.query: Generate–validate–repair architectures in NetOps and software engineering: workflows combining generative models with validators and repair modules
queries.rationale: Identify architectures and prior empirical evidence for staged generation+validation+repair in operational settings.

queries.query: LLM failure modes in operational tasks: hallucination, incorrect units/semantics, unsafe suggestions, overconfidence calibration, provenance issues
queries.rationale: Compile documented failure patterns of LLMs that are directly relevant to NetOps safety and correctness.
source_preferences: industry technical reports with reproducible examples
papers on calibration and uncertainty estimation

queries.query: Verifier-assisted LLMs, tool-use for grounded execution, chain-of-thought constraints, constrained generation (templates, DSLs) for safe config generation
queries.rationale: Survey methods to constrain LLM outputs (domain-specific languages, schema-constrained generation) and tool orchestration to improve correctness.

queries.query: Formal methods and decidable verification for network correctness: SMT-based checking, model checking for forwarding behavior, correctness proofs for config transformations
queries.rationale: Identify formal techniques that could serve as gold-standard validators or that expose limitations in validating LLM outputs.

queries.query: Benchmarks for LLMs in networking and AIOps: existing datasets, task suites (6G-Bench, TSNBench, OpsEval), limitations and validity critiques
queries.rationale: Assess existing benchmark families and critiques to avoid producing another shallow leaderboard and to design meaningful evaluations.

queries.query: Evaluation methodologies for operational correctness: simulation vs. production testing, fidelity of network emulators (Mininet, ns-3), best practices for NetOps experiments
queries.rationale: Collect methods for realistic evaluation environments and known fidelity gaps between emulation and production.

queries.query: Robustness testing and perturbation analyses for LLM-driven workflows: adversarial inputs, noisy intents, partial telemetry, and stress tests
queries.rationale: Identify approaches to probe LLM robustness in operationally meaningful perturbations and adversarial scenarios.
source_preferences: security conferences (USENIX Security, IEEE S&P) for adversarial LLMs

queries.query: Human-in-the-loop vs autonomous agentic NetOps: studies comparing operator oversight, trust calibration, and intervention policies
queries.rationale: Understand empirical evidence on when human oversight is necessary, and how human-machine interaction affects safety and throughput.
source_preferences: HCI venues (CHI), systems papers, industrial case studies, arXiv

queries.query: Metrics for operational correctness and safety in network config tasks: semantic correctness, reachability-preservation, policy equivalence, rollback success, time-to-repair
queries.rationale: Gather concrete metrics used in NetOps and propose operationally relevant evaluation criteria for LLM outputs.
source_preferences: networking conferences, operational measurement papers, Batfish/verification tool docs

queries.query: Related AIOps literature: automation in fault diagnosis, root-cause analysis, runbook automation, change-management automation
queries.rationale: Survey neighboring AIOps methods to borrow evaluation paradigms, failure analyses, and operational metrics.
source_preferences: IMC, SIGCOMM, arXiv, industry whitepapers with reproducible methodology

queries.query: Security and safety risks unique to LLM-driven NetOps: injection attacks via prompts, unsafe suggested ACLs/firewall rules, privilege escalation vectors
queries.rationale: Compile threat models and documented attacks relevant to automatically generated configurations or agentic behavior.
source_preferences: security conferences, arXiv, vendor advisories, CERT advisories, SANS reports

queries.query: Reproducibility, disclosure, and governance for AI-generated operational artifacts: best practices for model disclosure, prompts, audit trails, and provenance
queries.rationale: Collect guidance and prior proposals on disclosure, audit logs, and reproducibility for AI-assisted operational research and deployment.
source_preferences: AI ethics/governance venues, arXiv, policy labs, FAIR reproducibility guidelines

queries.query: Agentic AI researcher experiments and track rules (CNSM 2026 Agentic AI Researcher track): disclosure requirements, prior track examples, and accepted submissions (if any)
queries.rationale: Ensure alignment with CNSM 2026 track constraints and find prior examples or policy clarifications.
source_preferences: CNSM website, conference call-for-papers, accepted paper listings, arXiv submissions referencing the track

queries.query: Datasets, corpora and public task banks for NetOps experiments: configuration corpora, runbooks, operator intents, synthetic config generators
queries.rationale: Locate available datasets suitable for reproducible evaluation of LLMs for config generation, repair, and validation tasks.
source_preferences: GitHub, Zenodo, public university datasets, project pages (Batfish corpora), CAIDA/IMC datasets

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed publications or reputable preprints (arXiv) with verifiable metadata (title, authors, year, venue/identifier).
Works that directly address LLMs or generative models applied to networking / NetOps or that provide portable methods (validation, verification, tool orchestration).
Publicly accessible tools, code, datasets, or detailed methods that enable reproduction or clear methodological comparison.
Papers proposing evaluation methodologies, benchmarks, or failure-mode analyses relevant to operational correctness, safety, or reliability.
Security, governance, and disclosure guidance materials applicable to AI-driven operational workflows.
exclusion_criteria: Commercial marketing materials or blog posts that lack technical detail or reproducible artifacts (unless authored by major research labs with accompanying code).
Papers purely about NLP benchmarks with no operational or systems transferability to NetOps.
Non-English sources lacking reliable translation or verification, unless a canonical translation or summary is available.
Works older than foundational-network-verification classics unless they are necessary historical background (focus is on recent methods and LLM-era work).
date_rationale: Primary focus on literature from 2018–2026 to capture the rise of modern deep-learning AIOps and the LLM era (notably 2020–2026). Include earlier foundational network-verification and formal-methods papers as necessary to ground validators (e.g., HSA, Batfish predecessors). Recent material (2021–2026) prioritized for LLM-specific behaviors, agentic workflows, and benchmark critiques.
